details: The annual inflation rate in the Euro area is estimated to have dropped to 2.8% in June 2026, down from 3.2% in May, according to a flash estimate from Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union. This figure was below economists' forecasts of 3.0% and was largely driven by a slowdown in energy price growth. The unexpected easing of price pressures reduces the immediate urgency for the European Central Bank (ECB) to further raise interest rates.
title: Eurozone Inflation Falls to 2.8% in June, Easing ECB Pressure

details: China's official Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 50.3 in June 2026, surpassing the forecast of 50.1 and indicating a slight expansion in the manufacturing sector. This marks an improvement from the previous month's reading of 50 and suggests stronger economic momentum, with a significant shift towards AI-related exports as a key growth driver.
sourceName: National Bureau of Statistics of China (via SignalPro News)
title: China Manufacturing PMI Exceeds Forecasts in June

details: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled against President Trump's attempt to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, thereby reinforcing the Federal Reserve's long-standing political independence. The Court distinguished the Fed from other independent agencies, emphasizing its unique role in maintaining stable monetary policy free from direct political interference. This decision preserves Cook's position and strengthens the legal framework protecting future Fed governors.
sourceName: Free Press Kashmir (citing International New York Times)
title: SCOTUS Blocks Trump's Attempt to Remove Fed Governor Cook

details: The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation has reached its full enforcement deadline on July 1, 2026. This means all crypto-asset service providers operating within the EU must now be MiCA-licensed to conduct legal operations. This regulatory milestone aims to provide a comprehensive framework for digital assets across the bloc.
title: EU MiCA Crypto Regulation Officially Goes Live

details: Initial Jobless Claims in the United States decreased to 215,000 for the week ending June 20, 2026, down from 227,000 the previous week. This indicates continued resilience in the U.S. labor market, as fewer people are filing for unemployment benefits.
title: US Weekly Jobless Claims Decrease to 215K

details: The U.S. manufacturing sector expanded for the sixth consecutive month in June 2026, though at a slightly slower pace, with the ISM Manufacturing PMI registering 53.3%. This is a decrease of 0.7 percentage points from May. Concerns persist regarding price volatility, the Iran war, and tariffs.
title: US Manufacturing PMI Eases to 53.3% in June
